title: deduction guides for std::ranges::take_view
summary: The deduction guide is provided for std::ranges::take_view to allow deduction from range and number of elements.
html:
Defined in header <ranges>
template< class R >
take_view( R&&, ranges::range_difference_t<R> ) -> take_view<views::all_t<R>>;
 (since C++20)

The deduction guide is provided for std::ranges::take_view to allow deduction from range and number of elements.
